versions.changelog:
Initial release of the requirement-assessment skill

- Provides structured workflow for requirement clarification, analysis, and work-hour estimation.
- Proactively guides users to answer key background and technical questions before assessment.
- Outputs a detailed, multi-field Feishu Bitable (instead of markdown tables) for requirement and estimation tracking.
- Supports both standard and AI-assisted work-hour estimations across multiple roles and platforms.
- Highlights key project risks and ensures transparent communication of uncertainties.
